Grace and Anna are in the same class. The teachers' office is not far from my home. Grace drinks milk every morning. Best of all, your pronunciation is good.
Anna likes noodles too. I like my life very much. My friend Anna is very kind. Also, she is a student at that university.
Grace's favorite season is autumn. We often go to the gym together. After school, we play together.
